messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Rahul Pandey
rahul pandey... solid name. where you working these days?
Do you want the name of company or place?
company name - need to know where you're building your career
Interface.ai

interface.ai... the conversational ai platform that's trying to make customer support less painful. found you on linkedin - rahul pandey, sde-i at interface.ai, ex atlassian and edra labs. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/imrpandey
Yeah right

atlassian to interface.ai... from the big tech playbook to the startup hustle. that's a solid move - going from building for millions to building something that could actually change how businesses talk to customers. what made you jump from atlassian's comfort zone to the ai startup game?
My offer at Atlassian got revoked after that I joined Edra Labs and then switched to Interface.ai

ah damn... the classic atlassian bait and switch. that's rough but honestly might've been the best thing that happened to you. edra labs to interface.ai - you've been in the trenches building real stuff while your friends are still waiting for their "dream job" offers to not get pulled.

how long you been working total?
I have been working for a total of 15 months as a software engineer and for 8 months as a software engineer intern

what kind of role you looking for next?
I am looking for fullstack developer or backend engineer or AI Engineer roles.

fullstack, backend, or ai engineer... covering all your bases like a smart person. working at interface.ai probably gives you some decent ai exposure too. 

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
I am open to remote and any other city in India
1+ years + fullstack/backend/ai + open to remote/any city... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes
Do you have any opportunity for me right now?
nothing matching right now - if my team sends something good, i'll ping
Okay
cool. meanwhile, what's your salary expectation?
I am expecting a base of 28 and a ctc of 30
28 base, 30 ctc for 1.25 years... that's ambitious but not impossible if you've got the skills to back it up. what's your current salary?
My current salary is 19 fixed and 20 as ctc
19 to 28... that's a solid jump but doable if you're at the right place. interface.ai is decent experience - what's your notice period?
It is 60 days
got it. 60 days is standard but can be negotiated down if you find the right role. i'll keep an eye out for opportunities that match your profile and salary expectations.
Okay
perfect. now we wait for the right opportunity to come through.

Sure
  No I didn't have any questions. I will be waiting for you to send me some good opportunities.
cool. i'll ping when something good comes through.
Okay
perfect. i'll ping when something good comes through.
Hi
Hi

hey rahul

what's up?
Waiting for an opportunity

i'm still looking. nothing matching yet.

still nothing matching yet. i'm picky about what i send - has to actually fit your profile and salary expectations.

how's interface treating you lately?
Less learning opportunity here

got it. you're hitting a ceiling on growth.

what kind of learning are you looking for? new tech stack, bigger scale, different domain?
It's okay

"it's okay" is the most dangerous phrase in career talk

what's making you want to leave?
Bigger scale or scale something from base

perfect. you want to build something that actually matters, not just maintain legacy code.

i'm looking for roles where you can own a system from scratch or scale something to millions of users. that's where the real learning happens.

what's your notice period?
60 days

60 days is standard but we can work with that. companies that are serious about talent will wait.

you're locked in now. i'll slide roles when they're good... not just any random listing.

btw what's the vibe at interface.ai? like what's actually making you feel stuck?
The work here is very monotonous and not very organised. I am also not able to learn much

monotonous AND disorganized... that's the worst combo. you're basically stuck in a loop of cleaning up messes without actually building anything new.

i've seen this pattern before - startups that hit a certain size but don't mature their engineering culture. you're not learning because there's no structure to learn from.

what's your current salary?
It's 19 lakhs as base and 1 lakh as variable

got it. 19 base, 1 variable. so you're looking at a ~50% hike to hit 28 base.

that's ambitious but not impossible if you find the right company that values what you bring. especially with your backend experience at a conversational AI platform.

i'm looking for roles where you can actually build systems that matter, not just maintain legacy code. places that are scaling fast and need people who can think about architecture.
